what: 36611 Surfers Paradise Light Rail: the paper says only CC Barrier 130 m. The 2026 fencing programme's CON WK1 row 46, 'CCB - Hi Surf (West) to Ocean Ave', 15 Oct 2026, is 115 m of CCB Event at the same place and day; rows 45 and 47 are its fence (70 + 100 m clean against the paper's 165 m). So the 130 m moves from demarcation, where it was recorded this morning 'to confirm', to the event line the programme names.

ops.note: Mesh fence 165 m on the clean line (programme CON WK1 rows 45 and 47: Hi Surf West 70 m and SPLRS 100 m). Paper says CC Barrier 130 m, event or demarcation not written; recorded as CCB Event on programme CON WK1 row 46 (CCB - Hi Surf (West) to Ocean Ave, 115 m Event, 15 Oct).
